country.evidence_quote: May Trucking Company began business in 1945 as a local carrier in Payette, Idaho. Clarence and Opal May founded the company with just three tractors transporting cement products in Oregon and Idaho. Over 80 years later, May Trucking Company has expanded to multiple locations with operations throughout the United States.
